newsitem.title: CHAD: Chad parliamentary election set for November 24.
newsitem.headline: Chad parliamentary election set for November 24.

text.p: Chad's President Idriss Deby has signed a decree fixing November 24 as the date for parliamentary elections, state radio said on Thursday.

Nomads will vote at mobile polling stations around the vast Central African country between November 20 and 24. The electoral commission said the new 125-member national assembly would be installed on February 10.
Deby took power in an armed uprising in 1990. He won 69 percent of votes in the second round of presidential elections on July 3, 1996..
His supporters will contest the parliamentary election in a coalition of 30 mainly small parties, the Republican Front, led by Deby's Patriotic Salvation Movement.
